Name: UPDATED Kinky Craftables With Casks and Statues
Author: gamerfluid
Description:
Hello and thanks for taking a peek at my first upload for this site!

~[b][u]This mod has been updated for the Multiplayer release and should now work with your most current version of Stardew Valley[/u][/b]. 5/30/18

This mod is basically an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/540/?]update/extension of Impervox's mod[/url], which was an extension of a mod by undare that I can no longer find the page for. I thought this mod was great but found, like many, that there were glitches and an empty space from when casks were added to the game and the mod wasn't updated! So I played around with the tilesheet and "made" a sexy catgirl cask, along with editing the statue of endless fortune and statue of perfection to also be kinky. I tweaked a couple of machines and scarecrows to my liking as well, so I hope you enjoy. Now I'd like to share this update with everyone here!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/h3AIk9T.png[/img]

This is a basic drag-and-drop mod, no SMAPI necessary. Just replace your Craftables.xnb (after making a backup!) with this file and enjoy your strange new farm!

I am by no means a sprite artist, and welcome any other modders out there to take a crack at improving this mod. Also, I am not a programmer or game dev, but if you have problems installing this mod, let me know! Have fun with it!
